class Calculator {
  private total: number;

  constructor(start: number) {
    this.total = start;
  }

  add(x: number): number {
    if (x > 0) {
      this.total += x;
    } else if (x < 0) {
      this.total -= -x;
    }
    return this.total;
  }

  static create(start: number): Calculator {
    return new Calculator(start);
  }

  async fetchAndAdd(url: string): Promise<number> {
    const value = await this.loadValue(url);
    if (value && value > 0) {
      return this.add(value);
    }
    return this.total;
  }

  private loadValue(url: string): number {
    return url.length;
  }

  identity<T>(value: T): T {
    return value;
  }
}

abstract class Shape {
  abstract area(): number;

  describe(): string {
    if (this.area() > 0) {
      return "has area";
    }
    return "no area";
  }
}

class Circle extends Shape {
  constructor(private radius: number) {
    super();
  }

  area(): number {
    return this.radius * this.radius * 3;
  }
}
